summary: Israel Acquisitions Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing a seventh amendment to its business combination agreement with Gadfin Ltd. The amendment, dated June 15, 2026, extended the termination date to June 20, 2026. No other material terms were modified. The original BCA was entered on January 26, 2025 and amended multiple times. The registrant is the special-purpose acquisition company seeking to acquire Gadfin, which is a private Israeli company. The filing signals ongoing efforts to close the de-SPAC transaction. What to watch: the ability to meet the revised deadline and any further extensions or termination.
